The vmx code assumes that IDT-Vectoring can only be set when an exception
is injected due to the exception in question.  That's not true
if the exception is injected correctly
but its delivery is blocked due to a fault
the first exception was not delivered.
Fix by unconditionally dequeuing the pending exception
(or the second exception) if we see it in the IDT-Vectoring field.
